text:
emma (Finance Ops): Heads-up from Support 0: HelixBio received two March invoices. One PDF is missing the 'Spot instance compute' line (~$6,750). The other is a duplicate but shows SEK 6,750 instead of USD. Both PDFs were sent. Please triage; auditors need corrected docs.

kai (Billing Eng): On it. I can already see invoice_job-12299 ran, then retried 9s later. The retry had env.TRANSIENT=true which bypassed dedupe and validation paths.

lara (Revenue Ops): Customer note: "INV-2026-0356.pdf (no spot line) and INV-2026-0356-copy.pdf (SEK amounts). Which is final?" They want corrected invoice + credit note.

invoice-bot: alert invoice-generator job-12299 retried (reason: storage PUT timeout). task ids: job-12299 / job-12299-retry.

kai (Billing Eng): Quick log snippet:
```
2026-04-12T14:05:42Z INFO invoice_job-12299 start
2026-04-12T14:05:43Z ERROR storage PUT /tmp/inv_INV-2026-0356.pdf timeout
2026-04-12T14:05:44Z INFO retry job-12299-retry
2026-04-12T14:05:46Z INFO job-12299-retry completed (wrote INV-2026-0356.pdf)
2026-04-12T14:05:47Z INFO postprocess validation skipped (TRANSIENT=true)
```
Looks like retry skipped validation; likely read usage blob mid-write which produced the missing line. Duplicate because retry wrote and we sent both artifacts.

mike (Support): Customer: "We need a single corrected invoice for auditors and a credit note for the duplicate. Please confirm when available." :pray:

oliver (Accounting): Approve reissue + credit note. We need corrected PDF before COB. Include original file names and UUIDs in the credit note. Also VAT was set to 0% in both; customer provided EU VAT and needs it applied.

emma (Finance Ops): Action items: 1) block any auto-send until pre-send validation confirms expected lines (if usage>0) 2) re-run invoice_job-12299 with dedupe enforced 3) generate CN-2026-0061 referencing duplicate file 4) email corrected docs to billing@helixbio.com cc:acct@helixbio.com.

kai (Billing Eng): Will patch generator to never skip validation on retries and to wait for aggregator commit marker. Adding a pre-send blocker for missing expected lines. Pushing to staging now; will reissue once CI passes. ETA ~2h. Created ticket BILL-1489.

lara (Revenue Ops): Add canned customer text for support to send: "We mistakenly sent duplicate invoice documents due to an internal retry; please use the attached corrected invoice and attached credit note for your records."

mike (Support): I'll tell the customer ETA and pause automated payment capture for their account until reconciliation.

emma (Finance Ops): Please add a short RCA + remediation summary to BILL-1489 for the monthly billing postmortem. cc @eng-sre for storage consistency checks.

kai (Billing Eng): Will do. Will update thread when reissued.
